steps.hardClue: Activate the ancient artifact, then activate the four pedestals around the map.
steps.clue: Activate the Sentinel Artifact, then unlock Pack-a-Punch at the four pedestals.

steps.hardClue: Read the four altered clocks and set eight dials to the matching times.
steps.clue: Read the four altered clocks and set the eight elemental dials around the ship.

steps.hardClue: Kill four matching elemental enemies beside the sparking outlets.
steps.clue: Kill matching elemental Catalysts beside the four sparking outlets.

steps.hardClue: Complete the four elemental trials in a specific sequence.
steps.clue: Complete the Poison, Water, Electric and Fire trials in order to recover the Sentinel Artifact.

steps.hardClue: Shoot the nine leaking pipes with an elemental Wonder Weapon.
steps.clue: Shoot the nine leaking pipes with the Poison Kraken to flood the Boiler Room.

steps.hardClue: Place the artifact inside the Pack-a-Punch machine.
steps.clue: Pack-a-Punch the Sentinel Artifact in the Turbine Room.

steps.hardClue: Activate nine hidden planet symbols, then reveal their order using a model.
steps.clue: Activate the nine planet symbols, then reveal their order using the Cargo Hold model.

steps.hardClue: Shoot the planets in the displayed order and collect their falling orbs.
steps.clue: Shoot the planets in the displayed order and collect their falling orbs.

steps.hardClue: Collect the final orb, then destroy the ice blocks across the ship.
steps.clue: Collect the Sun orb, then destroy the ice blocks from the Forecastle to the Poop Deck.

steps.hardClue: Enter the final ritual and recover the artifact underwater.
steps.clue: Enter the final ritual and recover the Sentinel Artifact underwater.

steps.hardClue: Survive five phases and defeat the giant eye.
steps.clue: Survive the five boss phases and defeat the Eye of Odin.
